copy.intro: Your Elisa pendant goes with everything, and now the gold is starting to wear thin. That's the trade with Kendra Scott's fashion pieces, which are plated over brass. If you want the same colorful stones at a lower price, or with silver or solid gold underneath, these 15 brands make them. The ones named alongside Kendra Scott most often come first.

bodies.chan-luu:
Chan Luu is the pick if you like Kendra Scott's colored stones but want natural gemstones instead. The Camille Necklace Turquoise ($275) pairs turquoise with a bright citrine accent, and the Diana Necklace Multi ($390) mixes iolite, garnet, peridot and quartz.

It's a Los Angeles label founded in 1996, and it builds its pieces on traditional handwork. The Diana Necklace White Pearl ($350) is 18k gold plated sterling silver, so there's silver under the gold rather than brass. That's where the money goes. Nothing starts under $175, which makes it a real step up from the $70 Elisa.

US orders over $200 ship free by FedEx 2-Day. Returns close 15 days after shipping, half Kendra Scott's window. If you want gemstone beads for less, Anna Beck starts at $65.
bodies.ettika:
Ettika is the closest match on everyday prices. Most of its necklaces start under $100, and the Desert Bloom Marquise Cord Necklace in Turquoise ($60) costs less than an Elisa.

It's designed in Los Angeles, and like Kendra Scott it's plated jewelry, with 18k gold, rhodium or silver over zinc, steel or brass. Every piece is nickel free and lead free, which helps if nickel bothers your skin. Start with the cord necklaces. The Marquise Crystal Cord Necklace is $40, and pearl chokers top out the range at $250.

The catch is the return window. You get 14 days, and free US shipping only kicks in at $110, above Kendra Scott's $85. If you'd rather have a month to decide, BaubleBar gives you 30 days at similar prices.
bodies.nadri:
Nadri covers almost exactly Kendra Scott's price range, from the Large Cross CZ Pendant Necklace ($55) to an 18-karat gold chain at $5,699. Its specialty is cubic zirconia set to pass for diamond.

Start with the CZ Cross Pendant Necklace ($65), its best seller, or the Chloe Pear Drop Y Necklace ($68). Nadri owns its factory and works in plated brass, plated sterling silver and 14-karat gold with real diamonds, so one shop covers everyday pieces and fine jewelry.

Expect clear sparkle more than turquoise or opal, though. US shipping is free from $75, and refunds close at 14 days, or 30 for store credit. For colored stones on gold plating, Melinda Maria is the better fit.
bodies.jennifer-zeuner:
Jennifer Zeuner is where to go for small pendants made to wear in layers. The Inga Necklace ($185) hangs a half-inch letter charm on a delicate chain, in 18k gold plated silver or plain sterling silver.

Jennifer started designing in 2005, and the look is simple with a spiritual twist. It costs more than Kendra Scott day to day. Very little starts under $100, and the Hollis Necklace, a heart pendant in gold-plated brass, is $154. So pick the silver versions if plating wearing off brass is what sent you looking.

Returns run 14 days for a full refund, and sale or personalized pieces are final. If you want an initial pendant for less, TAI's Opal Glow Monogram Necklace is $55.
bodies.missoma:
Missoma is the way to trade up. It's a London demi-fine brand working in recycled 18k gold vermeil, and its US store prices in dollars with import duties already paid. The Lucy Williams Malachite Choker ($140) is the one to start with if you like Kendra Scott's green stones.

Vermeil here means gold over silver, the same build as Kendra Scott's own vermeil line, rather than plated brass. Prices start at $85 for a gold-plated rope chain and climb into solid gold, up to a diamond tennis necklace at $9,989. The December Birthstone Pendant Necklace ($179) sits in between.

Shipping is free over $150, and you get 90 days to return, the longest here. Each US return costs $7.95, though. For gold over silver with more turquoise, Anna Beck is the one to look at.
bodies.anna-beck:
Anna Beck is our pick for turquoise. Its necklaces are handmade in Bali in 18k gold plated over solid sterling silver, so there's real silver under the gold instead of brass.

Becky Hosmer started the brand on a trip to Bali in 2003, and its signature is a gold pendant with Balinese dotting. Start with the Turquoise Beaded Necklace ($195), which hangs that pendant from turquoise beads and can be engraved on the back. The Namaste Necklace ($385) pairs a turquoise pendant with pink tourmaline or apatite beads.

Free US shipping needs $250, the highest threshold here, and returns are 30 days, like Kendra Scott's. For turquoise at Kendra Scott prices, Ettika's turquoise cord necklace is $60.
bodies.sterling-forever:
Sterling Forever is worth a look for CZ pendants on a budget, and it gives you the most time to change your mind after Missoma. The Jamie CZ Evil Eye Pendant Necklace is $40, and the Calder Aquamarine CZ & Herringbone Pendant Necklace is $136.

It started in 2005 with a 15-year-old selling his mother's old jewelry, and it still aims at accessible prices. Plenty of the range starts under $100, and nothing passes $434. Every purchase comes with a lifetime guarantee. For a tennis necklace, the Helene Bezel Carribean Blue Opal Tennis Necklace is $290.

Returns run 60 days, double Kendra Scott's. Free shipping needs $200, though, and below that it's $5.95. If it's blue opal you want, Melinda Maria has pendants from $115.
bodies.baublebar:
BaubleBar has the deepest range under $100 on this list. Most of its necklaces start there, and the Chase Semi-Precious Pendant Necklace ($48) costs less than a Mini Elisa ($55).

It's a New York brand built on trend-forward jewelry. Look for the semi-precious beads, like the Mini Jane Semi-Precious Beaded Necklace in Lapis ($68), and the personalized pieces, like the 14K Gold Birthstone Charm Necklace ($80). There's no BaubleBar store to walk into. But Nordstrom stocks both brands, so you can compare them side by side.

US shipping is free from $75, and returns run 30 days from the shipping date. If you want the same prices with more turquoise, Ettika is the better match.
bodies.tai:
TAI makes small pendants with a bit of color, and most of the range starts under $100. The Opal Glow Monogram Necklace ($55) and the Hamsa Necklace with CZ and Opal Accents ($65) are the ones to start with.

Crescent moons and hamsas show up across the pendants, like the Nightmood Crescent Pendant Necklace ($70). If you're building a layered look, chains start low, with the Paperclip Charm Chain Necklace at $25. At the other end, a 4mm CZ tennis necklace tops out the range at $525.

US shipping is free over $100. The return window is short, though, at 10 days from delivery, so decide fast. If you need longer, Sterling Forever gives you 60 days on similar CZ pieces.
bodies.brinker-eliza:
Brinker & Eliza is for the more-is-more side of Kendra Scott, where one pendant is never enough. It's a mother and daughter team that makes every piece by hand, to order, mostly in 24k antique gold plated brass.

The Best Is Yet To Come Necklace ($98) is the entry point, a heart medallion on a gold-plated chain. Go bigger with the Mermaid Parade Necklace ($398), a chunky chain hung with semi-precious and gold-plated charms. Most pieces sit well above Kendra Scott's everyday prices, with the top at $448.

Because it's made to order, allow up to 10 business days before anything ships. Returns close at 15 days, and personalized pieces are final. For charm necklaces closer to $30, BaubleBar's start at $28.
bodies.lele-sadoughi:
Lele Sadoughi does statement necklaces, like collars and bolos that make a single Elisa look quiet. The Malachite Baroque Collar Necklace ($125) and the Turquoise Ruffle Heart Bolo Necklace ($150) carry the green and blue stones you'd find at Kendra Scott, just bigger.

The shop also sells headbands, hair clips and bags, so the necklace edit is small. It runs from the Baroque Pearl Collar Necklace ($95) to $385. Pearls run through it too, from the Three Strand Pearl Necklace ($225) to the Corfu Pearl Necklace ($295).

US orders ship free over $75. Full-price pieces get 14 days for a refund or 21 for store credit, and sale is final. If you'd like a month to decide, Melinda Maria gives you 30 days.
bodies.yam:
Yam's chokers are handmade to order by designer Morgan Thomas, who runs the brand out of Queens, New York. The Gold Sun Choker ($60) costs less than an Elisa, and the Posy Chain Choker is $145.

Thomas started the line as an ode to her late mother, who introduced her to jewelry making as a child. Most of the necklaces are chokers, so measure your neck before you buy. Pearls show up too, as in the Bonar Pearl Choker ($180).

Plan ahead. Production takes about eight days before anything ships, and returns are for exchange or store credit only, within 10 days of delivery. If you want the option of a refund, Ettika and BaubleBar both offer one.
bodies.melinda-maria:
Melinda Maria keeps every necklace between $75 and $250, roughly the band most of Kendra Scott's sit in. The She's a Boss Pendant Necklace in Blue Opal ($115) is the one to start with, and Blue Opal is a whole collection here.

The pieces use heavy gold plating made to look like 14k gold, with stones set and polished by hand and a protective coating for hypoallergenic wear. Every piece also carries Melinda's Lifetime Guarantee, which counts for more on plated jewelry than on solid gold.

Free US shipping starts at $75, and returns run 30 days, just like Kendra Scott. The catch is the ceiling. If you want real gold or diamonds later, Missoma and Nadri go much further.
bodies.stella-dot:
Stella & Dot sells gemstone necklaces for Elisa money, and the Kate Gemstone Necklace in Blue costs exactly $70. The Ava Paperclip Necklace comes in turquoise, rose quartz or mother of pearl for $55.

Most of its necklaces sit under $100, and the cheapest is the Power Stone Pendant Adjustable Necklace at $19.99. Brand Ambassadors sell it too, but the online store sells to anyone. Tennis necklaces sit at the top, with the Naomie Tennis Necklace at $225.

Free shipping in the continental US starts at $100, and you get 30 days to return. The range is the smallest of the lower-priced picks, so if you don't see your stone, BaubleBar has far more to choose from.
bodies.adornmonde:
Adornmonde is the solid-gold pick. Every necklace is 14k gold, from the Atticus micro bow necklace ($342) to the Luca heart diamond necklace ($606), so there's no plating to wear away.

It's an earring brand first, built around jewelry you can wear around the clock, and the necklace range is short. The Knoxx round diamond necklace ($382) uses a single round lab-grown diamond. It's all nickel free and lead free, so it suits sensitive skin.

US shipping is free on every order, and international orders over $320 ship free too. Returns close at 14 days, and anything bought in a sale is final. If you want gold over silver for less, Missoma's vermeil Malachite Choker is $140.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body: Start with your budget. Under $100, BaubleBar and TAI have the most to choose from, and Ettika is the closest to an Elisa on price. Between $100 and $250, Melinda Maria keeps everything in that band, and Lele Sadoughi does the bigger statement collars. If plated brass is the problem, change what's underneath. Anna Beck and Chan Luu put gold over sterling silver, Missoma uses vermeil, and Adornmonde is solid gold. Nadri and Missoma are the two that go all the way up to real diamonds. And if returns matter most, Missoma gives you 90 days and Sterling Forever 60, while TAI and Yam give you 10.

faqs.a: Mostly not. Its fashion jewelry is 14k gold or rhodium plated over brass. The vermeil line is 18k gold over sterling silver, and a smaller fine line is 14k gold, some of it with diamonds.

faqs.q: How much is a Kendra Scott necklace?
faqs.a: Most cost between $50 and $250. The Elisa Gold Pendant Necklace is $70 and the Mini Elisa is $55, while 14k gold pieces with lab-grown diamonds reach $5,695.

faqs.a: The plating can fade with wear, because the fashion pieces are gold or rhodium plated over brass. If that's your worry, look at gold over sterling silver, like Anna Beck, or solid gold, like Adornmonde.

faqs.q: Where can I buy Kendra Scott jewelry?
faqs.a: At kendrascott.com, which ships free over $85, at Kendra Scott stores, and at authorized retailers including Nordstrom, Dillard's, Macy's and Anthropologie. Buy from a retailer and its return policy applies instead of Kendra Scott's 30 days.
